payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the proposed model utilizes representations from the RxR dataset for language and visual encoding, while training the navigation agent on the R2R and CVDN datasets.

claims.text: The proposed model is trained on the navigation step of R2R and CVDN, while the representation step is taken from the RxR dataset.
The model uses multilingual BERT for language representation and ResNet for visual representation, both initialized from the RxR dataset.
